question_text: Construct day_summary(hours, temperatures) in Python. Both parallel lists contain 24 observations, one per hour 0..23. Define night as 20:00 through 05:59 inclusive. Return(maximum, minimum, overall mean, night mean). Use explicit comparisons and accumulation, not min, max or sum.
adaptation_rationale: Retains multi statistic parallel-list traversal; repairs source cross-midnight condition with OR, counts night observations, and uses safe extrema initialization.
